funding.name: Michigan Reconnect
funding.provides: Last-dollar scholarship that pays in-district community college tuition tuition-free for eligible adults, or gives a large tuition discount at an out-of-district community college.
funding.eligibility: Be at least 21 years old when you apply; have lived in Michigan for at least one year; have a high school diploma, GED, or certificate of completion.
